title: National Commission for Women (NCW) Helpline
description: 24/7 dedicated helpline offering immediate support, counseling, and intervention for women facing violence or harassment.

title: National Legal Services Authority (NALSA)
description: Free legal aid and advisory services to eligible women across district, state, and national legal service authorities.

title: iCALL Psychosocial Helpline
description: Free telephone and email-based counseling by trained mental health professionals for emotional distress, relationship issues, and trauma.

title: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana
description: Maternity benefit program offering cash incentives for pregnant and lactating mothers to improve health and nutrition seeking behavior.

title: Women Who Code & Tech Uplift
description: Global and regional mentorship networks, job boards, and free coding workshops designed to empower women in STEM careers.

title: Cyber Crime Reporting Portal
description: Official portal to report online cyber harassment, morphing, stalking, and identity theft with special priority given to women and children.
